# Sirach Chapter 27 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 27 | **Date:** 2026-03-17

---

**27:1** Many people have gone wrong chasing a small profit; if you're always trying to get more, you end up looking the other way.

**27:2** Sin drives itself like a wedge between buyer and seller the way a peg gets driven between two stones.

**27:3** If a person doesn't hold tight to the fear of the LORD, their house comes down fast.

**27:4** When you shake a sieve, the rubbish stays behind; when a person reasons something through, their faults show up.

**27:5** Fire tests what the potter makes; reasoning tests what a person is made of.

**27:6** You can tell how well a tree was tended by the fruit it bears; you can tell what's in a person's heart by the words they speak.

**27:7** Don't praise someone before you've heard them out — the proof of a person is in their character.

**27:8** If you pursue what is right, you'll reach it, and wear it like a robe of glory.

**27:9** Birds flock together with their own kind; truth comes home to the people who live by it.

**27:10** A lion lurks for its prey; so does sin lurk for the person who practices lawlessness.

**27:11** A devout person's conversation is always wisdom; a fool shifts around like the phases of the moon.

**27:12** Among the senseless, keep your time short; among thoughtful people, stay as long as you can.

**27:13** The talk of fools is offensive; their laughter reeks of sin.

**27:14** A compulsive swearer's oath makes your skin crawl; their arguments are enough to make you cover your ears.

**27:15** When people fight to the point of blood, it is evil; and the verbal abuse that comes with it becomes unbearable.

**27:16** Whoever betrays a confidence destroys loyalty, and won't find a true friend anywhere.

**27:17** Love your friend and stay faithful to him; but if you've given away his secrets, don't go looking for him.

**27:18** You killed the friendship the same way someone kills an enemy — it's dead.

**27:19** Letting your friend go after that is like releasing a bird from your hand — it's gone; you won't get it back.

**27:20** Don't even try to chase it — it's far off, like a gazelle that's sprung free of a snare. The wound to his soul is deep; there's no healing now, after the insults and betrayal.

**27:21** Silver and gold can recover from a stumble; but once you're exposed for betraying a friend's words, you can't undo it.

**27:22** The man who makes crafty eyes at you — who's safe from him?

**27:23** To your face he's all sweetness, full of admiration for what you say; but behind your back he twists it all and speaks poison about you.

**27:24** There are many things I despise, but nothing as much as him — and the LORD feels the same way.

**27:25** Throw a stone straight up in the air — it comes back down on your head. Strike someone treacherously — the blow bounces back on you.

**27:26** Dig a pit — you'll fall into it. Set a trap — you'll get caught in it.

**27:27** Do evil — it will come rolling back, and you won't even see it coming.

**27:28** The arrogant person gets mockery and contempt; vengeance waits for them like a crouching lion.

**27:29** Those who gloat over good people's suffering will themselves be trapped, and agony will devour them while they're still alive.

**27:30** Wrath and anger — these too are abominations, and the sinful person clutches them tight.
